pr_title: Fix async stop sometimes not properly collecting result
pr_body:
If the request finishes before the stop is called, but the result is not stored yet, we rely on async functionality to collect the response. I though that we are guaranteed that the data would be stored before the final handler is completed, but looks like it's not always the case. So this explicitly checks the task is finished before trying to collect.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/121249
pr_comments: Hi @smalyshev, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Hi @smalyshev, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.

@smalyshev 
I think the problem is that we wrap `runAfter` to remove the async listener too early: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/2fbec770158c421c316a0277df02f0f454fce7a7/x-pack/plugin/esql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/plugin/TransportEsqlQueryAction.java#L222.  

This is because the listener does not include storing results to the index: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/67ee03411bad5beb7e8000f0b3fcbc8accdf96da/x-pack/plugin/esql-core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/core/async/AsyncTaskManagementService.java#L191.  

We could avoid this issue if the `runAfter` wrap before dispatch to request to asyncTaskManagementService https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/2fbec770158c421c316a0277df02f0f454fce7a7/x-pack/plugin/esql/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/plugin/TransportEsqlQueryAction.java#L186). However, at that point, we don't yet have the async ID or executionInfo.

I'm a bit hesitant about this proposal in this PR because it would deduplicate the get-result logic more.

@dnhatn We don't change much logic-wise - we fetch the task ID anyway, the only change is that we'd wait for it to finish on one of the branches. As you note, if we move listener wrap earlier, we'd have to also move execution info creation and it may cause other problems?

More coherent explanation: sometimes, the execution listener is completed before the result data is stored (since the listener completion seems to be detached from the store completion, because we hook execution listener after it has been wrapped by async manager). In such cases, we may try to return the result before it has actually been stored properly.
